concern_results.conclusion: Traced the hook branch-by-branch: covered requires moves_head=0 + clean + commit-or-tree equality (equivalent to the two old quiet branches), quiet now additionally requires status exactly "passed", the covered-non-passed branch sets its own note/message and the uncovered assignment is guarded by [ "$covered" != 1 ] so neither overwrites the other; review_gate.py adds complete to anchors_wanted under the unchanged --base/no --paths condition and records only on the fully assembled success result after the failure branch returned, matching the plan's decision table row by row.

No credential, egress, packet, or permission boundary changes; the printed receipt path is the local git-dir path the hook already computed, message/note pass through jq --arg so receipt content is never executed, and the controller write reuses the existing anchored no-follow receipt writer; reminder stays non-blocking.

Missing/malformed receipt still degrades to silence via the hex guard and || true; missing status reads "?" and reminds (fail-safe direction); a failed completion returns rc=2 before the record call and the suite pins byte-identity with cmp -s; a HEAD-moving command forces covered=0 so the prior reminder still fires; complete without whole-worktree --base inherits the same no-anchor no-write behavior the bare --diff-file review case already pins.

Evidence is internally consistent with the fixture enumeration: 25 old + 6 new probes = 31, unfixed hook fails exactly the 5 new status/path cases, the passed-on-covered case stays green on the old hook, the status-predicate mutant fails exactly the 4 status fixtures, and reverting the completion write fails exactly the completion-success case; failed-completion byte-identity is pinned by cmp -s.

Receipt schema unchanged; pre-existing findings receipts covering HEAD now remind, which is the declared correction; coverage fixtures moved from hard-coded findings to default passed so they keep testing coverage rather than disposition; consumers of the hook JSON see only added text.
Single-commit revert restores prior behavior; the reminder never denies or asks so a false reminder cannot block a command; no migration, state conversion, or irreversible step.

All four reminder forms (no receipt, covered non-passed, uncovered HEAD, HEAD-moving) name the receipt path read, and the covered non-passed message carries mode, status and recorded_at so the exact artifact can be opened; the uncovered-HEAD template's path fragment is the one variant without a dedicated assertion, but it shares the template other probes exercise.

Claims stay within the suites run; the single make test exit 2 (abort-leak leg2 claude wrapper alive at 55s under load) is disclosed with isolated re-runs green rather than asserted as a pass, and the completion-receipt test is honestly described as an untracked passed review plus complete, not a findings chain closed through a dispositions file.

Shared-gate change is contained: hook remains advisory and the controller change appends a receipt write to one existing success path without touching verdict, budget, chain, completion-success criteria, or authorization logic; both changed behaviors have killing mutations.

hooks/AGENTS.md non-wording rule is met by the deterministic suite plus recorded review and challenge, and the header keeps advisory-vs-blocking explicit; root AGENTS.md baseline-then-RED and scope rules hold; backticked specs/ tokens in the new markdown resolve to files added in the same diff; the late charter and non-prescribed review entry are self-disclosed in extraction-closeout.md with a pending human decision rather than hidden, and no quoted rule is itself defective or loosened.
